correctness.rationale: Use cosine homeomorphism to identify exactly m/2+n/2 full branches of slopes m,n. Cylinder widths multiply, establishing iid weighted branch symbols and unique Lebesgue acip. Full-shift coding gives unique MME, topological entropy log((m+n)/2), metric entropy (log m+log n)/2 and the sign Bernoulli laws. Endpoints form a countable zero-entropy exceptional set. Explicit proof covers all m,n congruent 2 mod 4. Runnable exact checks agree on five pairs and 630 sign words.
